name: rosetta-sorting-algorithms-sleep-sort
code:
// Each value waits its own number of scheduler turns rather than any
// real time, so values one apart still wake in order.

use IO.Std.write_line
use Ghul.Coroutines

let values = [5, 3, 8, 0, 1, 9, 2, 7]

emit(value: int) -> COROUTINE is
    for _ in 1::value do
        await pause()
    od

    write_line("{value}")
si

for value in values do
    emit(value)
od

run()
